description: This file defines the SugarCacheAPC class, a PHP class that extends the SugarCacheAbstract class to implement caching functionality using APC (Alternative PHP Cache). It includes methods for checking backend usage, setting, getting, deleting, and resetting cache entries via APC functions.

classes.name: SugarCacheAPC
classes.description: A class extending SugarCacheAbstract that provides APC-based caching implementation.

methods.name: useBackend
methods.description: Determines if APC can be used as the cache backend based on availability and configuration settings.

methods.name: _setExternal
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair in APC cache with an expiration timeout.

methods.name: _getExternal
methods.description: Retrieves a value from APC cache for a given key, returns null if not found.

methods.name: _clearExternal
methods.description: Deletes a cache entry associated with the given key from APC.

methods.name: _resetExternal
methods.description: Clears the entire APC user cache.
